note: Caveman FX default rules (docs/fx-hook-plan.md). Each fx state is a BoolAsset Animation/Caveman/FX.<Name> in the Caveman-FX mod; FX decks trigger on them. pulse rules suit OneOff decks (bursts), level rules Continuous ones (auras, trails).

rules.note: one shot as the kickflip starts

rules.when: flip in [popshuvit, fspopshuvit, 360popshuvit, fs360popshuvit, n_popshuvit, n_fspopshuvit, n_360popshuvit, n_fs360popshuvit]
flip not in [none, ollie, nollie, olliepop, n_olliepop, wallie, fswallie, bswallie, bonedollie]
air && flip in [none, ollie, nollie, olliepop, n_olliepop, wallie, fswallie, bswallie, bonedollie]
rules.note: in the air but not flipping: fx.flip takes over during a flip trick, so the two auras never show together
